# semaphore_ex_option (Data Source)

Reads one persisted global system option. Only the selected value is stored in state. Values are sensitive because system options may contain credentials. The persisted value may require a server restart to become effective.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_option" "example" {
  key = "example.option"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Exact system option key.

### Read-Only

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Persisted option value.
